description: This PHP class defines the Worksheet writer component for the PHPSpreadsheet library, responsible for serializing a Worksheet object into XML format conforming to the XLSX specification. It includes methods to write various worksheet elements such as sheet properties, dimensions, view settings, data, drawings, styles, protections, and conditional formatting, facilitating the export of spreadsheet data into a compatible XLSX file.

classes.name: Worksheet
classes.description: This class handles the process of converting a Worksheet object into its corresponding XML representation within an XLSX file. It manages writing elements such as sheet properties, data, styles, protection, drawings, conditional formatting, and other worksheet settings, ensuring the generated XML conforms to the Office Open XML standards.

methods.name: writeWorksheet
methods.description: Main method that orchestrates the writing of a worksheet to XML, initializing the XML writer, and calling subsidiary methods to write each worksheet component.

methods.name: writeSheetPr
methods.description: Writes the <sheetPr> element, including macro requirements, tab color, outline options, and page setup properties.

methods.name: writeDimension
methods.description: Outputs the worksheet's dimension reference, defining the used cell range.

methods.name: writeSheetViews
methods.description: Writes worksheet view options such as zoom, gridline visibility, headers, and frozen panes.

methods.name: writeSheetFormatPr
methods.description: Defines default row height, column width, and outline levels.

methods.name: writeCols
methods.description: Writes column dimension settings, including widths, hidden state, and styles.

methods.name: writeSheetData
methods.description: Serializes the sheet data: rows and cells, including each cell's value, type, style, and formulas.

methods.name: writeCellInlineStr
methods.description: Writes a cell of type inline string with its text data.

methods.name: writeCellString
methods.description: Handles writing string cell values, utilizing a string table for shared strings.

methods.name: writeCellNumeric
methods.description: Writes numeric cell values, ensuring proper formatting.

methods.name: writeCellFormula
methods.description: Writes cell formulas, with optional pre-calculation of formula results.

methods.name: writeCell
methods.description: Coordinates the writing of a single cell element, including value, style, and formula.

methods.name: writeDrawings
methods.description: Includes drawing and chart relationships if present.

methods.name: writeLegacyDrawing
methods.description: Links comments via legacyDrawing element if comments exist.

methods.name: writeLegacyDrawingHF
methods.description: Includes header/footer images via legacyDrawingHF if header/footer images exist.

methods.name: writeAlternateContent
methods.description: Handles supplemental alternate content as raw XML.

methods.name: writeExtLst
methods.description: Outputs extension list elements, especially conditional formatting extensions.
